metadata.scenario: A frantic call from a hotel manager needing urgent pest control service before the arrival of VIP guests. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I need urgent help! Oh no, Agnes! What seems to be the problem? It’s about my companion care visit. I need to reschedule urgently! Of course, I can help you. What’s the reason for the urgency? I just found out that my daughter is bringing some VIP guests over today! I see, that sounds important. When do you need the visit rescheduled for? I was hoping for this afternoon, but I need someone who can handle... Handle what, Agnes? Please, go on. They’re not just any guests; they’re very particular. I can’t have anything out of place! I understand. We want to make sure everything goes smoothly for you. Right. And I need someone who can assist with light housekeeping too, please. We can coordinate that. Let me check our staff availability for this afternoon. Thanks, Margaret. I really appreciate it. It’s just that I want everything perfect for them. Absolutely, Agnes. How about if I send a Personal Care Assistant to help? Yes, that would be perfect! Great! The cost for personal care assistance is between $28 to $35 an hour. That’s fine. Just make it happen! I’ll arrange that right away. Do you need them for a specific number of hours? Maybe for two hours, just to get everything in order. Got it. I’ll set them up for two hours starting at 1 PM. Thank you! I knew I could count on you all. Just one moment while I finalize the details. Sure, take your time. I’ll be here. Alright, Agnes. I’ve just scheduled a Personal Care Assistant for you at 1 PM. Perfect! Thank you so much for your help. You’re welcome! I’ll also follow up with you after the visit to ensure everything went well. That would be great. I really appreciate all of this! Of course! I’ll keep you updated on everything. I’m so relieved. Thank you again, Margaret! You’re very welcome, Agnes. Have a wonderful time with your guests! I will! Bye now. Goodbye, Agnes!
